title: Red-team break-in at a consolidated allied intelligence facility

tellings.quote: he and I broke in to this 30,000 C facility

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former US Army intelligence man, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a security test in Germany in the 1970s. He says he and another man acted as a red team, people who play intruders to see if a site's security holds, and broke into a large intelligence facility shared by the US and its allies. He tells it as an example of the kind of work he did before his later psychic research.
